local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=0
local elapsed=0
local baselineReported=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching original Harrada')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 elapsed=elapsed+dt
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 local plant=util.vector3(-1393.248779296875,2230.81298828125,-35.23634719848633)
 local distance=(plant-self.position):length()
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if not baselineReported and elapsed>=2 then
  assert(math.abs(health-99.54000854492188)<.1,'Unexpected damage during far Harrada control')
  print('KvatchHarrada far control stable');baselineReported=true
 end
 print('KvatchHarrada control ready position='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..tostring(types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current))
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(plant+util.vector3(0,0,250))
 local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('KvatchHarrada aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.3f',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5))),distance))
 if math.abs(ax)<.04 and math.abs(ay)<.06 then print('KvatchHarrada facing ready') end
 if distance>350 then print('Harrada separated far') end
 if distance<140 then print('KvatchHarrada near original plant') end
end}}}}
